transkript.t: You hit your Claude code limit again, and a lot of what used it up was waste.
There are three leaks, and by the end, you'll know how to plug all three.
Every message resends your agent's instructions, every tool it has loaded, and the whole chat so far.
So, it rediscovers the same build command every session, carries tools it never touches,
and when it's stuck, it keeps retrying the same failing fix.
Microsoft Research and Berkeley just open sourced Token Economizer to fix that.
It's a free plugin for Claude code, Codex, and Copilot.
It remembers facts about your repo once three sessions confirm them.
Drops tools you never use, and when your agent loops on the same error,
a judge steps in and tells it to try another way.
On real GitHub tasks, that cut costs by 18 to 31%, so your usage goes further.
It learns over time, so a brand new project saves less.
Comment tokens and I'll send you the install steps.
